statements.impact_statement: The advisory affects Prometheus's /api/v1/read remote-read handler. R1 MeshDB compiles selected labels, parser, storage-interface, and TSDB utility packages, but its verified runtime closure excludes github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote and contains no remote-read HTTP handler.

statements.status_notes: Ratio1 backports the maintained negative DataRow field-length check from pgx commit 7f382f5190f58c16f5bd9d60f4443b658a5a3a22. The patched source and direct plus full-frame regressions are hash-pinned in source/ratio1-engine-overrides.json.

Ratio1 backports the official Apache Thrift Go compact-protocol varint bound from commit d5152211af61f850ec393604316804096dd4632e. Exact implementation preimage, patched source, and boundary regression hashes are enforced by source/ratio1-engine-overrides.json.

Ratio1 backports the official gRPC-Go receive-buffer compaction fix from commit 8cfeca0e1ee5ea0980dcc320e20240fa1079ec77 to the engine's vendored v1.82.1 source and the Cloudflared build's vendored v1.83.0 source. Exact preimage, patch, distributed-source, and regression hashes are enforced by the provenance and security verifiers.

statements.impact_statement: The minimal runtime retains only the setsid executable from util-linux. The vulnerable DOS/EBR parser, libblkid, blkid, findmnt, mount, and related libraries and utilities are absent; mount checks read /proc/self/mountinfo directly.

The advisory affects target-path handling in the setuid mount executable for restricted user mounts. The scratch runtime retains only non-setuid setsid from util-linux; mount, umount, libmount, /etc/fstab, and the vulnerable restricted-mount path are absent.

The vulnerability is confined to analyze_string in the infocmp command. The minimal runtime retains libtinfo for Bash and the database binary but contains no infocmp executable or ncurses command package.

The advisory affects SSH server authentication reached through ssh.NewServerConn. The database engine excludes golang.org/x/crypto/ssh from its vendored runtime closure. Cloudflared compiles that package only for sshgen public-key parsing and authorized-key marshaling; an exact-source Go AST gate permits only ssh.NewPublicKey and ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey and rejects server configuration or authentication use.
